Parlange, Ph.D., P.Eng., President DATE: June 26, 2025 SUBJECT: Discussion Item: Update on the Comprehensive Campus Plan Purpose of Submittal: To update the Committee on the progress of the Comprehensive Campus Plan (CCP). Points to Consider: In June of 2024 the University, with Sasaki, kicked off the Comprehensive Campus Plan. • Phase 1 - Discovery and Analysis was completed in October 2024. • Phase 2 - Planning Scenarios were mostly completed in January 2025. • Phase 3 - Campus Plan Development January 2025 - June 2025. • Phase 4 - Final Documentation (July 2025-September 2025). This presentation will provide an overview of the draft final plan, which is in support of the University’s strategic plan. This overview will discuss a framework for the redevelopment of campus, future vision for Kingston campus neighborhoods, open space and landscape opportunities, mobility and circulation strategies , and sustainability initiatives. This overview will also provide a vision for the Narragansett Bay Campus, building on its existing master plan. Feedback from the Board will be incorporated by Sasaki and the URI Planning team as they finalize the plan over the summer. The plan will be brought to the Board for approval in September. Review of the Enacted Budget Vice President Abby Benson noted that the official State budget has not been approved yet.
She provided a brief overview of the University’s FY25 Budget request, specifically the requests for an operating budget increase, Rhode Island Capital Plan Fund (RICAP), and a Biomedical Sciences Building General Obligation (GO) Bond.
With respect to the operating budget increases, she noted that URI requested a $32.1M increase, the legislature recommended a $5.4M increase.
With respect to RICAP asset protection funding, she noted that URI requested $16.3M, the legislature recommended $14.0M.

She discussed the FY24 forecast, with least likely and most likely scenarios compared to budget.

Parlange, Ph.D., P.Eng., President DATE: June 10, 2024 SUBJECT: Action Item: Approval of Amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding between URI and the University of Rhode Island Foundation and Alumni Engagement Purpose of Submittal The University is seeking approval from the University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees for an amendment that would provide for a one-year extension to the existing Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the University of Rhode Island and the University of Rhode Island Foundation and Alumni Engagement (URIFAE).
Recommendation I recommend that the University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees approve the amendment to the MOU.
Points to Consider The University and the URIFAE have mutually agreed to a one -year extension of their existing MOU, which expires on June 30, 2024 and will now expire on June 30, 2025.

The terms of the MOU will remain the same, with some minor adjustments to the University’s financial and in-kind contribution to the URIFAE, as outlined in Exhibits C and D.
Supporting Information See attached amendment and original executed MOU.
Proposed Motion THAT, the Board of Trustees hereby approves Amendment One to the Memorandum of Understanding with the University of Rhode Island Foundation and Alumni Engagement, as recommended and presented, and that the Board Chair, President, and Vice President of Administration and Finance are each individually authorized, for and on behalf of the University and the Board of Trustees, to execute Amendment One to the Memorandum of Understanding, as recommended and presented.

AMENDMENT ONE TO THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND AND THE UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND FOUNDATION AND ALUMNI ENGAGEMENT This AMENDMENT ONE (the “Amendment”) to the Memorandum of Understanding between the UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND, a public institution of higher education established by the laws of the State of Rhode Island, for itself and on behalf of its governing board, the UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND BOARD OF TRUSTEES , a public corporation created and established pursuant to Chapter 32, Title 16 of the General Laws of Rhode Island (together referred to as “URI”), and the UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND FOUNDATION AND ALUMNI ENGAGEMENT , a Rhode Island non -profit corporation (the “Foundation”, and together with URI, the “Parties,” and each, a “Party”), is entered into as of the 1 st day of July, 2024 (the “Effective Date”).

WHEREAS, the Parties entered into a Memorandum of Understanding dated as of July 1, 2021 (the “Memorandum of Understanding”); and WHEREAS, the Parties desire to extend the term of the Memorandum of Understanding for an additional year and further wish to amend the Memorandum of Understanding as described herein; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows: 1.
Definitions.
Capitalized terms used and not defined in this Amendment have the respective meanings assigned to them in the Memorandum of Understanding. 2.
Amendments to the Memorandum of Understanding .

As of the Effective Date, the Memorandum of Understanding is hereby amended as follows: (a) Section 7.1 of the Memorandum of Understanding is hereby deleted and replaced in its entirety with the following: “This Agreement is effective for a term of four (4) years (the “Term”) commencing on July 1, 2021 and continuing through June 30, 2025.” (b) For the portion of the Term running from July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2025, Exhibits C and D to the Memorandum of Understanding are hereby replaced in their entirety by the respective Exhibits C and D attached to this Amendment.
For the avoidance of doubt, the original Exhibits C and D to the Memorandum of Understanding remain in effect and unmodified with respect to the portion of the Term running from July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2024.

3. Date of Effectiveness; Limited Effect. This Amendment becomes effective as of Effective Date. Except as expressly provided in this Amendment, all of the terms and provisions of the Memorandum of Understanding remain in full force and effect. On and after the Effective Date, each reference in the Memorandum of Understanding to “this Agreement, ” “the Agreement, ” “hereunder,” “hereof,” “herein,” or words of like import will mean and be a reference to the Memorandum of Understanding as amended by this Amendment. 4. Miscellaneous. (a) This Amendment may be executed in counterparts, each of which is deemed an original, but all of which constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of this Amendment electronically shall be effective as delivery of an original executed counterpart of this Amendment. (b) This Amendment constitutes the sole and entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained herein and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, agreements, representations, and warranties, both written and oral, with respect to such subject matter.
